questions.question: What is the first complete high-salience homepage section after TCG Pocket, and where does it end?
questions.answer: POKÉMON CHAMPIONSHIP SERIES; it follows TCG Pocket and ends before Play! Pokémon.

questions.question: What are the section-local desktop boundaries, stacking and reading order at 1440?
questions.answer: The article is 1440x720. Its row is flex with row-reverse: the 720x720 image is on the right and the 720-wide content column is on the left. The 696x377.578 content box begins at local x=12 and is vertically centered at local y=(720-377.578)/2, approximately 171.211. Article, row, columns and content are transparent; the visible white is the page canvas.

questions.question: What changes at 390, including order and geometry?
questions.answer: The article is 390x829.1719 and the row becomes block. The 390x390 image is first; content follows at local x=8,y=390,w=374,h=439.172. Backgrounds remain transparent and the white remains page canvas.

questions.question: Which official image is rendered and can its bytes be frozen?
questions.answer: The img declares championships.jpg at 1x and championships-2x.jpg at 2x. Both are archived and hashed. In the observed 390px browser session currentSrc selected championships-2x.jpg; src is not treated as proof of the selected response.

questions.question: What typography and CTA rules are directly observed?
questions.answer: At 390 the H2 is Kanit 700 at 32/32.5 within local x=32,w=326,h=97.5 and has 8px bottom margin. Body copy is PT Sans 400 at 18/28.8 within local x=32,w=326,h=201.578. CTA is local x=99.625,w=190.742,h=51.297 with 16px top margin, 14.4px by 36px padding, PT Sans 700 at 18/22.5, black background, white content, 2px radius and shadow. Exact desktop typography boxes were not separately frozen.

questions.question: Are settled, hover, focus, activated/destination and reversible scrolling evidenced?
questions.answer: Desktop and 390px mobile default/settled, hover, keyboard focus and destination are independently frozen; the CTA destination is https://championships.pokemon.com/en-us/. Desktop and mobile scrolling also have before/restored captures.

questions.question: Is a Dembrandt similarity score available?
questions.answer: No. Dembrandt was unavailable in this evidence run; no score or threshold result is claimed.
